products.title: Organic Stretch Long Sleeve Top
products.body_html:
A fitted long sleeve in organic cotton with a touch of stretch, perfect for gentle movement and crisp mornings.

Cut close to the body and slightly cropped with a streamlined fit, this top offers gentle flexibility without feeling restrictive. Ideal for cool mornings, warm-ups, and outdoor workouts as a touch of extra coverage without the bulk. Easy, sleek, ready for anything.

Dress Code 
GOTS certified organic cotton. OEKO-TEX® certified for human health. The Climate Label certified for reduced environmental impact. Certified B Corp for social and environmental accountability.

products.title: Organic Stretch High Neck Tank
products.body_html:
A high neck tank in organic stretch cotton, designed to add polished ease from warm-up to workout and beyond.

The minimal silhouette sits close to the body and offers gentle flexibility, while an interior shelf bra provides built-in support. A clean neckline and minimal finish make it an easy foundation for movement and layering. Supportive, sleek, versatile.

Dress Code 
GOTS certified organic cotton. OEKO-TEX® certified for human health. The Climate Label certified for reduced environmental impact. Certified B Corp for social and environmental accountability.

products.title: Organic Stretch Crop Racer Tank
products.body_html:
A classic racer tank with a built-in shelf bra and a smooth, supportive fit.

Designed for movement and everyday wear alike, in soft, breathable organic cotton with gentle stretch that moves naturally with the body. The scoop neckline and racerback keep the silhouette clean, while close-to-body support makes it an easy layer for everything from low-impact workouts to everyday dressing. Supportive, streamlined, versatile.

Dress Code
GOTS certified organic cotton. OEKO-TEX® certified for human health. The Climate Label certified for reduced environmental impact. Certified B Corp for social and environmental accountability.
- Made with 92% Organic Cotton, 8% Spandex
- GOTS Certified Organic Cotton by Control Union, #1245496
- Mid-weight blend, 300 gsm
- Made from Organic Cotton with a touch of stretch, this fabric is soft, breathable, and designed to move with you. It offers close-to-body comfort with natural flexibility and a smooth, supportive feel against the skin.
- Machine wash cold with like colors, tumble dry low. Do not bleach.
- Made in India
- XS: Chest 26 in; Length 16 3/4 in
- S: Chest 28 in; Length 17 1/4 in
- M: Chest 30 in; Length 17 3/4 in
- L: Chest 32 in; Length 18 1/4 in
- XL: Chest 35 in; Length 18 3/4 in
The MATE Dress Code brings your values into each fiber and fabrication.

GOTS Certified Organic - Certified by the Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS) organically grown and responsibly processed, meeting strict environmental and social criteria that promote safer, fairer working conditions across the entire supply chain. GOTS supports reduced chemical use, healthier soil, and responsible water management for lower environmental impact.

Tested with OEKO-TEX® - Finished materials are certified to OEKO-TEX® Standard 100, meaning every component is tested for a wide range of harmful substances and verified safe for human use.
